title: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
description:
1. Select a manageable load, clear the area, and take a stable starting position for Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift.
2. Take a wide stance with the bell between the feet, hinge and bend the knees to grip it, then stand by extending the hips.
3. Return the load under control and repeat for the programmed repetitions.
